title: Oregon Blew Up a Whale With Dynamite (1970) 💥
description:
In 1970, the Oregon Highway Division tried to remove a dead, beached whale with half a ton of dynamite. It went exactly as well as you think.
Sources: Wikipedia "Exploding whale"; KATU (Paul Linnman's 1970 report); Mental Floss; Jalopnik (the crushed car); Salem Reporter (quarter-mile account); Eugene Weekly & Willamette Week (Exploding Whale Memorial Park, 2020).

title: Mike the Headless Chicken Lived 18 Months Without a Head 🐔
description:
In 1945, a Colorado chicken named Mike survived losing his head, then toured as "Miracle Mike" for 18 months. This really happened.
Sources: Wikipedia "Mike the Headless Chicken"; BBC News (2015); Guinness World Records; Mental Floss; LIFE.
